features.title: Answer agent grep and glob from a resident fff index
features.summary: On every agent/created the bundle registers Agent-scoped grep and glob tools that shadow the stock ripgrep-backed ones with the same names and arguments, served from one fff index per search root in a worker thread.
failureModes: An invalid regular expression is an error, not a literal search.
A crashed worker fails its pending calls and the next search starts a fresh one.
Agents created before the bundle loaded keep the stock tools until their next start.

verification.testName: finds every non-ignored match with workspace-relative paths
narrows to a directory, an include glob and a single file
reads a pattern that looks like an fff constraint as a regular expression
caps shown matches but reports the total
rejects an invalid regular expression instead of searching for it literally
matches basenames at any depth and anchors to a directory

verification.reason: grep and glob are agent tools with no browser UI of their own; the search behaviour runs against a real fff index in tests/fff-search.test.ts.
